record.question: Which city has hosted 2023 Hero Tri-Nation International Football Tournament?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
The All India Football Federation’s 6 February 2023 announcement scheduled the tournament’s three matches at Khuman Lampak Stadium in Imphal, Manipur. Its 22 March match report records the opening fixture there. These sources establish the host city for the 2023 event; they say nothing about later tournament venues.

Reference: https://www.the-aiff.com/article/hero-tri-nation-friendly-tournament-to-be-held-in-imphal-from-march-22-to-26-india-to-play-myanmar-kyrgyz-republic
